I added a new mod, **Click Fireworks**. It's on now.

- **Every click** sends a rocket up from the bottom of the screen with a sparkly trail. It slows near the top and bursts where you clicked, with a flash and coloured sparks that fall slowly. Some bursts are rings and some sparks twinkle.
- **Hovering "Get it"** sprays confetti out of the button for as long as your mouse is on it.
- Your clicks still work normally. The effects are drawn on a see-through layer that clicks pass through.

**What I checked:** I faked a click and a hover on "Get it", then took a screenshot. It showed the rocket climbing and confetti flying off the button. There were no errors, and your other mods (gravity, jelly buttons, living robot, neon title) are still running. I haven't seen a full burst in a screenshot: the rocket was still rising when I took it.
Making the bursts much bigger: more sparks that fly further and last longer, full-rainbow colours, and second-stage crackle bursts.

The bursts are now huge. My test burst was about 600px across, roughly three-quarters of the screen's height, and it covered the robot, title, buttons and both text columns.

**What changed:**
- **Size:** bursts scale with your window, so they stay about half the screen across at any size.
- **Colour:** about half the bursts sweep the whole rainbow around the circle. The rest use a mixed palette with an outer ring and an inner core in contrasting colours.
- **More fireworks:** each burst has about 470 sparks instead of 90, with longer trails, and they hang in the air about twice as long before fading.
- **Crackles:** some sparks pop into small bursts of their own partway out, and sparks twinkle as they fade.
- I capped the total number of sparks so the page stays smooth if you click a lot.

**What I checked:** I faked a click, waited about a second and took a screenshot. It showed the full rainbow burst with crackles going off inside it, and there were no errors. The "Get it" confetti is unchanged.

To undo it, switch off **Click Fireworks** in the side panel, or ask me to.
